microtheory.name: physics_foundation
microtheory.definition: Classical mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, special + general relativity. The pre-quantum physics framework grounding most engineering, much chemistry, and astronomy. Newton's laws, Maxwell's equations, the laws of thermodynamics, Einstein's relativity. Substrate analogue: substrate's macroscopic dynamical framework.

concepts.name: newtons_laws
concepts.definition: Three laws of motion (Newton 1687). 1: inertia. 2: F = ma. 3: action-reaction. Foundation of classical mechanics.

concepts.name: force
concepts.definition: Vector cause of acceleration. F = ma. SI unit: newton. Substrate analogue: substrate's directional state-change driver.

concepts.name: mass
concepts.definition: Scalar measure of inertia and gravitational coupling. m. SI unit: kilogram. Substrate analogue: substrate's persistence quantity (resistance to state-change).

concepts.name: velocity
concepts.definition: Vector rate of change of position. v = dx/dt. SI unit: m/s. Substrate analogue: substrate's trajectory rate in state space.

concepts.name: acceleration
concepts.definition: Vector rate of change of velocity. a = dv/dt = d²x/dt². SI unit: m/s². Substrate analogue: substrate's second-order state change.

concepts.name: work
concepts.definition: Energy transferred by a force acting through a displacement. W = F·d (scalar product). SI unit: joule. Substrate analogue: substrate's accumulated state-change cost.

concepts.name: momentum_classical
concepts.definition: p = mv. Conserved in absence of external force. Substrate analogue: substrate's persistent-direction quantity.

concepts.name: energy_kinetic
concepts.definition: KE = ½mv². Energy of motion. Substrate analogue: substrate's activity-magnitude.

concepts.name: energy_potential
concepts.definition: PE = mgh (gravitational), ½kx² (spring), etc. Energy of configuration. Substrate analogue: substrate's basin-depth.

concepts.name: conservation_energy
concepts.definition: Total energy of isolated system constant. Foundation of mechanics. Substrate analogue: substrate's invariant quantities.

concepts.name: conservation_momentum
concepts.definition: Total momentum of isolated system constant. Newton's 3rd + 2nd combined. Substrate analogue: substrate's symmetry-conserved quantities.

concepts.name: angular_momentum
concepts.definition: L = r × p. Conserved under rotational symmetry. Substrate analogue: substrate's rotational invariant.

concepts.name: lagrangian_mechanics
concepts.definition: Lagrange 1788. L = T - V. δ∫L dt = 0 → Euler-Lagrange equations. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-minimisation formalism.

concepts.name: hamiltonian_mechanics
concepts.definition: H = T + V. Hamilton's equations: q̇ = ∂H/∂p, ṗ = -∂H/∂q. Foundation of statistical mechanics + QM. Substrate analogue: substrate's energy-based dynamics.

concepts.name: noether_theorem
concepts.definition: Every continuous symmetry → conserved quantity. Time translation → energy; space translation → momentum; rotation → angular momentum. Substrate analogue: substrate's symmetry-invariant correspondence.

concepts.name: first_law_thermodynamics
concepts.definition: ΔU = Q - W. Energy conservation including heat. Substrate analogue: substrate's energy-balance principle.

concepts.name: second_law_thermodynamics
concepts.definition: Entropy of isolated system never decreases. dS ≥ 0. Substrate analogue: substrate's information-degradation arrow.

concepts.name: third_law_thermodynamics
concepts.definition: Entropy → 0 as T → 0. Absolute zero unreachable. Substrate analogue: substrate's zero-temperature limit.

concepts.name: entropy_thermodynamic
concepts.definition: S = k_B ln Ω. Statistical: log of microstate count. Boltzmann's tombstone formula. Substrate analogue: substrate's disorder measure.

concepts.name: temperature_statistical
concepts.definition: 1/T = ∂S/∂U. Temperature is reciprocal of entropy's response to energy. Substrate analogue: substrate's β parameter.

concepts.name: heat_engine
concepts.definition: Device extracting work from temperature difference. Carnot efficiency η ≤ 1 - T_c/T_h. Substrate analogue: substrate's gradient-driven work extraction.

concepts.name: boltzmann_distribution
concepts.definition: P(state with energy E) ∝ exp(-E/k_BT). Foundation of statistical mechanics. Substrate analogue: substrate's CAN basin probability.

concepts.name: partition_function
concepts.definition: Z = Σ exp(-E_i/k_BT). Generates all thermodynamic quantities. Substrate analogue: substrate's normalisation constant over basin states.

concepts.name: maxwell_equations
concepts.definition: Four equations describing all classical electromagnetism (Maxwell 1865). Gauss's laws, Faraday, Ampère-Maxwell. Predict EM waves traveling at c.

concepts.name: electric_field
concepts.definition: E. Force per unit charge. Substrate analogue: substrate's potential gradient.

concepts.name: magnetic_field
concepts.definition: B. Generated by moving charges + intrinsic spin. Substrate analogue: substrate's circulation field.

concepts.name: electromagnetic_wave
concepts.definition: Self-propagating E + B fields at speed c. Light, radio, X-rays, gamma. Maxwell 1865 prediction confirmed by Hertz 1888.

concepts.name: lorentz_force
concepts.definition: F = qE + qv × B. Force on charged particle in EM field.

concepts.name: gauge_invariance
concepts.definition: EM equations invariant under change of vector potential by gradient of any scalar. Foundation of modern field theories.

concepts.name: special_relativity
concepts.definition: Einstein 1905. Two postulates: physics same in all inertial frames; speed of light constant. Consequences: time dilation, length contraction, E = mc². Substrate analogue: substrate's frame-relative invariants.

concepts.name: time_dilation
concepts.definition: Δt' = Δt/√(1-v²/c²). Moving clocks run slower. Confirmed by GPS, muon decay.

concepts.name: length_contraction
concepts.definition: L' = L√(1-v²/c²). Moving objects contracted along motion.

concepts.name: mass_energy_equivalence
concepts.definition: E = mc². Mass is a form of energy. Foundation of nuclear physics + cosmology.

concepts.name: lorentz_transformation
concepts.definition: Transformation between inertial frames replacing Galilean. Mixes space + time.

concepts.name: minkowski_spacetime
concepts.definition: Minkowski 1908. Unified 4D spacetime with metric ds² = -c²dt² + dx² + dy² + dz². Substrate analogue: substrate's combined spacetime view.

concepts.name: general_relativity_grav
concepts.definition: Einstein 1915. Gravity = spacetime curvature. Einstein field equations G_μν = 8πG/c⁴ · T_μν. Foundation of cosmology.

concepts.name: equivalence_principle
concepts.definition: Gravitational + inertial mass identical. Locally, gravity indistinguishable from acceleration. Substrate analogue: substrate's frame-equivalence principle.

concepts.name: spacetime_curvature
concepts.definition: Mass-energy curves spacetime; matter follows geodesics in curved spacetime. Substrate analogue: substrate's geometry-shaped trajectories.

concepts.name: geodesic
concepts.definition: Straight line in curved spacetime — path of free-falling object. Generalisation of Euclidean straight line.

rules.name: noether_links_symmetry_to_conservation
rules.head: Jabberwock observes a conservation law
rules.body: Noether: there's a corresponding continuous symmetry. Energy ↔ time-translation, momentum ↔ space-translation, charge ↔ gauge.

rules.name: second_law_sets_arrow_of_time
rules.head: Jabberwock considers temporal asymmetry
rules.body: the second law (entropy increase) is the macroscopic arrow of time. Microscopic dynamics time-reversible; macroscopic not.

rules.name: boltzmann_distribution_governs_equilibrium
rules.head: Jabberwock has system in thermal equilibrium
rules.body: state probabilities follow Boltzmann distribution P ∝ exp(-E/k_BT). Substrate's CAN at finite temperature.

rules.name: speed_of_light_is_universal_limit
rules.head: Jabberwock considers signal propagation
rules.body: no signal exceeds c. Special relativity. Substrate's causal-cone constraint.

rules.name: mass_energy_are_equivalent
rules.head: Jabberwock considers nuclear or cosmological process
rules.body: E = mc². Mass can convert to energy + vice versa. Foundation of nuclear power + Big Bang nucleosynthesis.
